bucket_reason: Medium confidence after the funded close_chain stage: the chain case is closed, but it rests on one bound for words that start with 1 (L9), which holds on every run checked and is not proved, so proof.md waits.
question: Fund one more stage to prove L9 (PC < 2^(D+1) for words that start with 1) and then write proof.md, write proof.md now with L9 as an open lemma, or park?

options.label: One stage: prove L9, then write proof.md
options.consequence: Plan: find, natively, an invariant that ties the f weight of the word after a flush to the epoch length N, check it on random instances, then prove it by hand. If it closes, every phi-eat is covered and proof.md follows at high confidence. Stop rule: if L9 does not close within the stage, write proof.md with L9 stated as the one open lemma.

options.label: Write proof.md now, with L9 stated as an open lemma
options.consequence: Gives you a reviewable Checkpoint B document sooner: rules, flush lemmas L1-L8 and the chain lemmas C0-C5. It cannot go to formalization until L9 is proved.

options.label: Park
options.consequence: Everything is in notes.md, deepen.json and scripts/chain_check.py, so a later stage can resume without redoing work.
